en: A black-and-white image showing a group of men, likely military cadets or students, performing gymnastics in an outdoor yard. The men are dressed in uniform-like clothing, with some wearing caps and others in athletic attire. Two men are performing handstands on parallel bars, while another group practices on a pommel horse. The building in the background is a large, institutional structure, possibly a barracks, school, or gymnasium, with symmetrical windows and a stone foundation.
